about: The daily newsletter's words (newsroom/build/features/newsletter.mjs; Dinis, 6 November 2026, board/guidance/2026-11-06-the-daily-newsletter.md). An edition is content/newsletter/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<morning|evening>.md; newsroom/build/words/newsletter.json holds only the index's words and the email's frame.

index.title: The daily newsletter
index.summary: Two editions a day through Web Summit Lisbon: the morning edition (what is on today) and the evening edition (what happened, the latest). Each is a page here and a short email with links.
index.intro: From Saturday 7 November, a morning edition by 07:30 and an evening edition by 19:30, Lisbon time. Each edition is a public page; its email version is plain text with links back here, because the pictures and the live pages are on the site.
index.subscribe: The email goes out from the Web Summit team, who hold the list, the consent and the sending. PrompTugal.news keeps no subscriber, address or private note.
index.none: The first edition is Saturday morning, 7 November.
